data-retention-body:
We are allowed by law required to retain certain records for a period of at least five years after closure of your Avantio Channel Manager contract which will include your business data (including users data) and your clients, owners, intermediary agents or suppliers. Otherwise, to comply with the principles of the new regulation, we will delete and destroy all personal data that we hold about you when you (or we) terminate your Avantio Channel Manager contract.

In accordance with the rights conferred by current legislation on the protection of Personal Data, you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, limitation of processing, deletion, portability and opposition by sending your request to the following address contact@avantio.com.
data-security-body:
We are committed to the security of your data. We strive to protect the information you provide to us from loss and misuse, as well as from unauthorized disclosure or access. These measures take into account the sensitivity of the information we collect, process and store, as well as the state of the art of current technology. Once logged into App Avantio, all internet communication -including channel manager connections- is secured using Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology.

Given the nature of communications and information processing technology, we cannot guarantee that the Information, during its transmission over the Internet or during its storage on our systems or otherwise at our expense, will be absolutely secure from intrusion by others.

If you are concerned that any of your data have been compromised, please contact immediately our Customer Support department and tell us the reasons why you think your data have been compromised. Once we have received your information, we will use strict procedures and security features to prevent unauthorised access.
